title: First Documentation of Two Rare Fern Species in Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve, Yunnan, China
content:
We report two rare ferns in Menglun Sub-reserve in Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve, Yunnan Province, China. These represent the first documented distribution of the previous Laotian endemic fern species in Yunnan and China as well. Our observations confirmed the shared plant diversity in China-Laos border and also represent the need for more survey in the transboundary regions and joined efforts in the assessment of conservation needs as well as planning of conservation actions crossing the borders of several nations.


ABSTRACT

Transboundary conservation actions have been recognized as essential in our efforts to stop the loss of biodiversity. However, lack of information on species distributions in transboundary regions and accordingly the understanding of the threats in these areas impairs conservation. During a preliminary survey of ferns and lycophytes in Menglun Sub-reserve of the Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve, Yunnan, China, two species were collected and identified as new records, which are the new Chinese record of Leptochilus wusugongii, new record of Hymenasplenium wusugongii in Mengla County, and the rediscovery of populations of Cyrtomium latifalcatum, these first two species were only newly published and recorded in Laos. This study represents the need for more survey in the transboundary regions and joined efforts in the assessment of conservation needs as well as planning of conservation actions crossing the borders of several nations.

摘要

跨境保护行动已被公认为阻止生物多样性丧失的重要举措。然而, 跨境区域物种分布信息的缺乏, 以及由此导致的对这些区域威胁因素认知的不足, 制约了保护工作的开展。在对中国云南西双版纳国家级自然保护区勐仑子保护区的蕨类和石松类植物进行初步调查时, 采集并鉴定出两个新记录种, 即中国新记录种Leptochilus wusugongii和勐腊县新记录种Hymenasplenium wusugongii, 同时重新发现了Cyrtomium latifalcatum的种群；其中前两个物种此前仅在老挝有新近发表和记录。本研究表明, 跨境区域需要开展更多调查, 并需要在保护需求评估以及跨越多国边界的保护行动规划方面加强合作。
